record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, add a residual feed-forward block to GRU outputs before the unchanged causal pooling: z_t=h_t+W2*GELU(W1*h_t), with bottleneck width 64 and zero-initialized W2 and output bias. This starts with the incumbent computation and lets one jointly trained network learn nonlinear corrections to recurrent states. Preserve the GRU backbone, embeddings, history selection, pooling weights and half-life, scoring, loss and optimizer. Synchronize architecture construction in the predictor writer and checkpoint loader.
